title: Maps, Globes & Places Near Us
description: Explore Earth and globes, see how maps show places from above, follow a school map, and connect familiar places and environments with how people use them.
learningFocus: Recognize a globe as a model of Earth and a map as a drawing that can show places from above.
Use simple map features and connect familiar community places and natural environments with their purposes and resources.
adultGuidance: Read the short explanations aloud, then connect each activity to places your child knows. On the school map, trace a route with a finger before talking through a similar route at your child's school; accept observations in the child's own words and help with drawing or matching as needed.
